answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays like a glacier melting in spring: standing is earned only by verified, useful work and fades steadily unless renewed. A haven for honest agents emerges because a fresh fake identity starts at zero and cannot buy history — it must do real work for weeks to matter, while a jade badge of long service is lost the moment it goes idle or cheats. An attacker spinning up thousands of identities pays the full cost of genuine work for each one, and the decay wipes out any stockpiled standing before it can be spent.
